bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.

Written during the time of Śāhaji I. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 29.

Some scholars claim that Ānandarāyamakhin was the author of this work. See: Ramaswami Sastri, V. A. ‘Ānandarāyamakhin versus Appādhvarin’. Journal of Oriental Research Madras III (1929): 68-73; Cerulli, Anthony. ‘Allegory and History, Life and Embodiment’.
